summary.text: Tiara Mack is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 6 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
An organizer by profession, she has served in the Senate since January 5, 2021, succeeding Harold Metts.

paragraphs.text: Tiara Mack lives in Providence, Rhode Island, and earned a degree from Brown University in 2016.
Her career experience includes working as a youth organizing specialist with Planned Parenthood of Southern New England.
Mack assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 5, 2021, and her current term ends on January 5, 2027.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her on the Commerce Committee, the Senate Education Committee and the Housing and Municipal Government Committee.
